message: The other day, I was trying to teach my kids about kitchen safety while whipping up dinner. I had a mini fire drill planned—explaining smoke alarms and our escape plan—when my youngest decided it was more fun to pretend the oven was a rocket ship! 🚀 I realized that making safety lessons playful not only keeps them engaged but helps them remember too. Who knew a little imagination could spark such important conversations? What silly moments have turned into valuable lessons for you?
